Medium Affected: WATER

SkyTruth Analysis

Reported Spill Volume: 5 gallon
Report Description
CALLER STATED A MOTOR VEHICLE STRUCK A POLE HOLDING A TRANSFORMER. THIS RESULTED IN THE TRANSFORMER COMING DOWN AND A SPILL OF NON PCB TRANSFORMER OIL. CALLER STATED THE SPILL REACHED A STORM DRAIN DUE TO A SEWAGE LINE FROM A GAS STATION THAT IS BACKED UP. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: CALLER STATED THE SEWAGE LINE FROM THE GAS STATION IS BACKED UP AND IS LEAKING BIO-HAZARD FLUIDS OUT OF THE BLACKTOP RIGHT ALONG THE ROAD. CALLER STATED THOSE FLUIDS ARE GOING UPSTREAM OF THE OIL IMPACT OF THE GROUND SO THE BIO-HAZARD FLUIDS ARE PICKING UP THE OIL AND HAVE PUT THE SPILLED TRANSFORMER OIL INTO THE STORM DRAIN AS EVERYTHING FLOWS TOWARD THE STORM DRAIN. CALLER STATED THE SPILL FROM THE TRANSFORMER WOULD HAVE WENT ONTO THE BLACKTOP/CONCRETE BUT SINCE THE SEWAGE LINE IS BACKED UP THE SPILL HAS REACHED THE STORM DRAIN.

BOOMS AND SPILL RESPONSE MATERIALS WERE PLACED IN AND NEAR THE CREEK TO PREVENT RUN OFF OF ANY OIL FROM MOVING DOWN STREAM. INDIVIDUAL IS REPORTING THAT SHE WAS STATIONED AS AN OBSERVER ABOARD THE F/V LADY ANN MARGARET. FOR SET NUMBERS 8-14 THE CAPTAIN HAD ATTACHED APPROXIMATELY FIVE, 500ML PLASTIC BOTTLES, RANDOMLY ALONG THE FIRST HALF OF THE MAINLINE SET. EACH BOTTLE WAS FILLED WITH FUEL AND HAD BEEN PRICKED WITH A PIN WITH THE INTENT OF HAVING THE FUEL SLOWLY LEAK OUT OF THE BOTTLE, WHILE THE GEAR WAS SOAKING. CAPTAIN HAD PLACED THE BOTTLES ON THE LINE AS A WHALE DETERRENT, FIGURING THAT THE SMELL OF THE LEAKED FUEL IN THE WATER WOULD DISCOURAGE THE WHALES FROM APPROACHING AND FEEDING FROM THE GEAR. THIS INFORMATION WAS LEARNED THROUGH A CONVERSATION WITH THE CAPTAIN. I HAD ASKED HIM ABOUT THE BOTTLES AND HE TOLD ME THE ABOVE INFORMATION ABOUT WHAT THE BOTTLES CONTAINED, AND WHY HE PLACED THEM ON THE LINE.
